name: 工单直连域基线（直连·评测夹具）

cases.question: 工单总数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按状态统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 通知里未读的有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification WHERE deleted = 0 AND read_status = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 知识库里已发布的文章有多少篇？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按通知类型统计通知条数
cases.goldSql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY type
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 3 行。

cases.question: SLA 违规记录有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按违规类型统计 SLA 违规次数
cases.goldSql: SELECT violation_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY violation_type
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: 分派规则一共有几条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dispatch_rule WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按启用状态统计 SLA 策略数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT enabled, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_policy WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY enabled
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 知识附件一共有多少个？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_attachment WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 浏览量最高的那篇知识文章的标题是什么？
cases.goldSql: SELECT title FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY view_count DESC, id LIMIT 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 每篇文章平均有多少个附件？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0) AS avg_attach FROM knowledge_attachment WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: SLA 违规记录里逾期最久的是多少分钟？
cases.goldSql: SELECT MAX(overdue_minutes) AS max_overdue FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按分类统计知识文章数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY category_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 每张工单平均有多少条流转记录？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0) AS avg_flow FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 有 SLA 计时记录的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_id) AS cnt FROM sla_timer WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 知识文章的总浏览量是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(view_count) AS total_view FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 有帮助数最高的知识文章标题是什么？
cases.goldSql: SELECT title FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY helpful_count DESC, id LIMIT 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 每个工单分类下已关闭工单的数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'CLOSED' GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 逾期分钟数超过 600 的 SLA 违规有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0 AND overdue_minutes > 600
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 附件总大小是多少字节？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(file_size) AS total_size FROM knowledge_attachment WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按工单状态统计通知数量（通过工单关联）
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification n JOIN ticket t ON n.biz_id = t.id WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 AND n.type = 'ticket' GROUP BY t.status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 平均每张工单产生多少条评论？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0) AS avg_comment FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 已关闭的工单从创建到关闭平均用了多少小时？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, closed_at)) AS avg_hours FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: AI 推荐分类与工单实际分类一致的工单占全部工单的比例是多少？用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ai_category_id = category_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按工单 id，统计每张工单的流转次数和评论数，没有记录的显示 0
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS flow_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_cnt FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN ticket_flow f ON f.ticket_id = t.id AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ticket_comment c ON c.ticket_id = t.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 50
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 50 行。

cases.question: 列出每条 SLA 违规记录对应的工单编号和违规类型
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.ticket_no, v.violation_type FROM sla_violation v JOIN ticket t ON v.ticket_id = t.id WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY v.id LIMIT 50
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 50 行。

cases.question: 解决违规和首次响应违规各有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT violation_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY violation_type
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: 没有 SLA 计时记录的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sla_timer st WHERE st.ticket_id = t.id AND st.deleted = 0)
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 知识文章里，有附件的文章占比是多少？用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_article a2 WHERE a2.deleted = 0) AS ratio FROM knowledge_article a JOIN knowledge_attachment att ON att.article_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND att.deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 工单评论一共有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按工单来源统计数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY source
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 知识分类一共有几个？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_category WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 通知总条数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 工单流转记录一共有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: SLA 计时记录有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_timer WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按动作类型统计分派规则数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT action_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dispatch_rule WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY action_type
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: 已读通知有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification WHERE deleted = 0 AND read_status = 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按状态统计知识文章数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: 评论里内部备注有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 AND is_internal = 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 浏览量最低的已发布知识文章标题是什么？
cases.goldSql: SELECT title FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY view_count ASC, id LIMIT 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 文件大小最大的附件是哪个文件？
cases.goldSql: SELECT file_name FROM knowledge_attachment WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY file_size DESC, id LIMIT 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 每个分类下知识文章的平均浏览量是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT category_id, AVG(view_count) AS avg_view FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY category_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 按读取状态统计通知数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT read_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY read_status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: SLA 策略里解决时限最长的是多少分钟？
cases.goldSql: SELECT MAX(resolve_time) AS max_resolve FROM sla_policy WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 有附件的知识文章有多少篇？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT article_id) AS cnt FROM knowledge_attachment WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: SLA 违规里已升级的有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按工单优先级统计流转记录数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow f JOIN ticket t ON f.ticket_id = t.id WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.priority
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 知识文章标题里包含「支付」的有多少篇？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 AND title LIKE '%支付%'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 平均每张工单对应多少条 SLA 违规记录？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0) AS avg_violation FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 各知识分类下已发布文章的平均浏览量和平均点赞数分别是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT category_id, AVG(view_count) AS avg_view, AVG(helpful_count) AS avg_helpful FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY category_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 2025 年创建的工单按来源统计已关闭的数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED' AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY source
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 首次响应违规和解决违规的平均逾期分钟数分别是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT violation_type, AVG(overdue_minutes) AS avg_overdue FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY violation_type
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: 既有流转记录又有评论的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ticket_flow f WHERE f.ticket_id = t.id AND f.deleted = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ticket_comment c WHERE c.ticket_id = t.id AND c.deleted = 0)
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 评论数最多的 5 张工单，各自有多少条评论？
cases.goldSql: SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ticket_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, ticket_id LIMIT 5
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 按知识分类统计文章数量和总浏览量
cases.goldSql: SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(view_count) AS total_view FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY category_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: SLA 违规中逾期 1000 分钟以上的占比是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN overdue_minutes > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 各处理团队的平均解决时长（小时）是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT team_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, resolved_at)) AS avg_hours FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 6 行。

cases.question: 知识文章里草稿状态的有多少篇？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 每个工单分类下的 SLA 违规数量（通过工单关联）
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation v JOIN ticket t ON v.ticket_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE v.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。
